player_action: Read FIRST-SESSION ROUTE PREVIEW and LANGUAGE SAVE ROSTER on the start screen, select NEW or RESUME for a coding language, then read HUD, move with WASD, and look with mouse
success_signal: Start screen shows language rows, per-language NEW/RESUME actions, Java/C/C+/C++/Python/MATLAB save availability, protected terminal -> survivor marker -> extraction preview, language-only save slot/resume status, and player moves without UI overlap
fallback_guidance: Preview uses the current/default profile; each row deploys only the clicked language, and Simplified hints can reduce HUD control text after gameplay begins.

player_action: Follow route stripe, objective panel, queued radio briefing, radio relay, objective panel, radio scan beacon, NAV MAP nearest cue, HUD FIRST TEN MINUTES FIELD CHECKLIST, and journal FAIL-SAFE OBJECTIVE BOARD
success_signal: Player reaches New York entry without blocked access while understanding the active language route scan, queued radio briefing survives HUD startup, radio relay names language, terminal, survivor, landmark, and next step, the radio scan beacon points to the active terminal, the HUD field checklist keeps protected terminal -> survivor marker -> extraction plus current phase/recovery keys visible, and the fail-safe objective board names the selected language, save slot, return markers, protected terminal safety, and start-screen Resume state
fallback_guidance: Press T to return to active route; use the minimap legend to distinguish code, survivor, language, aid, and threat markers, read the field checklist for E/Ctrl+P/J/P/Esc cues, or open J for T objective jump, Backspace/F8 safe recovery, and P/Esc pause/save reminders.

success_signal: Player recovers to safe city arena location
fallback_guidance: Recovery subtitle and log marker appear.

player_action: Fire, reload, swap weapon, collect scanner, flashlight, ammo pouch, bypass kit, armor, and medkit
success_signal: Player sees ammo/reload/weapon HUD feedback plus scanner, flashlight, ammo pouch, bypass kit, armor, and medkit counts
fallback_guidance: Use Q medkit and squad support if pressured; L flashlight and Z scanner confirm the expanded field kit.

success_signal: Player sees regroup, formation, medic, hold/follow feedback with named role pips, role-specific callouts, role signal light, support-fire recoil, medic pulse, and order acknowledgment cues
fallback_guidance: Squad HUD line reports Mira/Tomas/Ada/Noor/Briggs status, active roles, pips, medic readiness, current order, and CompanionGestureReadability visual cues.

objective: Enter interior mission spaces; Inspect challenge concept rooms; then open protected terminal
player_action: Inspect hospital, school, store, transit, and civic records interiors; walk the variables lab, loop control room, array index hall, function relay room, debugger test bay, and curriculum-first review gallery; confirm the nearby case file can be collected; then interact with terminal
success_signal: Player sees room labels, mission boards, functional pickups, selected-language concept rooms, a saved case-file pickup, the active lesson artifact, and eight visible/hidden validator stations with mentor/survivor proxies before combat pauses and the coding editor opens
fallback_guidance: Use E/Enter/Tab/G on terminal marker; the journal case-file summary confirms saved optional context, and the gallery explains why hidden tests prove generality.

player_action: Read prompt, use PRACTICE RUN [Ctrl+P], then submit starter/correct solution
success_signal: Practice feedback shows PRACTICE RUN - NO SAVE ADVANCE, PRACTICE-ONLY DEBRIEF, Practice Run Lock, unchanged selected-language save profile, and live validation still available; pass/fail feedback explains the committed result with POST-SOLVE DEBRIEF or REPAIR DEBRIEF guidance, ObjectiveRouteToast confirms Terminal solved, Survivor route open, and score gain after success, REWARD CHOICE KIOSK offers one Research Boost, Field Kit, or Crafting Cache after live solve, journal LAST LEARNING DEBRIEF stores the latest selected-language takeaway, CHALLENGE REPLAY BRIEF stores replay guidance, and LANGUAGE PROFILE RECAP updates profile stats and review recommendation
fallback_guidance: Use practice run before committing, choose one reward after live solve, use hints, first failed check text, the next validation move, the saved journal debrief, CHALLENGE REPLAY BRIEF visible goal and hidden-test replay note, LANGUAGE PROFILE RECAP stage recap/profile stats/save-slot preview, and the route toast if the next objective is unclear.

success_signal: Survivor rescue records once, the post-rescue line names the active language fix, ObjectiveRouteToast confirms Survivor rescued, Extraction ready, and Language save refreshed, the rescue beacon changes from SURVIVOR PING to RESCUE BEACON, the journal dossier changes from ROUTE OPEN to RESCUED, and the SURVIVOR INTEL ARCHIVE mirrors that rescued status after resume
fallback_guidance: Journal shows active route summary, LAST LEARNING DEBRIEF, CHALLENGE REPLAY BRIEF, LANGUAGE PROFILE RECAP, FAIL-SAFE OBJECTIVE BOARD, survivor intel dossier, SURVIVOR INTEL ARCHIVE, text-first active/completed state labels, the journal field ops readout, language save, route map, field inventory, survivor intel, and dispatch confirms helipad route, save update, and RESCUED dossier/archive after resume.

player_action: Open P/Escape, save a language backup, settings
success_signal: Player can save a manual backup without losing the start-screen language resume slot, and the HUD CHECKPOINT SAVED route toast names the active language resume path
fallback_guidance: Settings menu scrolls on smaller displays, previews queued accessibility/audio/gameplay choices, and Save Backup refreshes the active language run.

success_signal: Extraction debrief shows NEXT OPERATION, active language save, cleared-city redeploy choices, and an expanded extraction set piece with rooftop, convoy, boat, rail, bridge, or helipad-command staging
fallback_guidance: Use T after graduation to move to next route.

player_action: Read HUD learning line, open J for LANGUAGE PROFILE RECAP, and if an end-state appears confirm the language resume summary
success_signal: Player understands language/streak/no-hint progress, profile stats, review recommendation, stage recap, save-slot preview, and where the selected-language run will resume
fallback_guidance: Replay tutorial from pause if confused; death/victory screens show the start-screen language resume slot.
